text:
akshay: plan to roll the updated autoscale policy to dedicated GPU pool slice-7 tomorrow 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC. Changes: tighter scale-down (2m -> 1m), burst_capacity +20%, and backoff tweak. need owners & rollback ready. :eyes:
liz: ack. I'll run the smoke checklist and take primary for rollback if needed.

liz: smoke checklist i'll run (quick list):
- hit /health on all slice-7 endpoints
- run 3x 512-token gen at p95 load (local loadgen)
- validate kv-cache warmup by calling representative chat flows
- confirm metrics in console (latency, queue depth)
- hit fallback path (force small pool) and confirm degrade path

akshay: perfect, call out if any test fails. plan is canary 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 15m windows. rollback immediate if p95 latency increase > 30% or error rate > 0.5%
tom: FYI infra change required: we need to bump node-pool max by 2 before canary or autoscaler may reject bursts. I've queued the GKE resize; will finish by 15:30 UTC.
maya: Oncall here. I'll watch alerting dashboards during rollout and be on pager for 1hr after full cutover. If alerts spike, i'll trigger rollback.

akshay: quick verification commands if needed:
```
# check current policy
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/dedicated/policies/slice-7
# force canary fraction
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"canary_fraction":0.1}' https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/deploys/trigger
```

tom: noted. I will share k8s node add logs to #eng-releases when done.

liz: smoke run scheduled 16:05-16:12 UTC. I'll paste quick summary here after each step.
akshay: thanks. tagging @deploy-bot for rollout trigger when we say go.
deploy-bot: queued rollout job 9f3a2, awaiting manual start.

oncall-bot: alerting policy for slice-7 set to high-sensitivity for rollout window.

liz: SMOKE: /health all green. 3x gen at p95 looks stable (latency +8%), queue depth normal. kv-cache warmup confirming. metrics visible in console. no errors.

akshay: excellent. starting canary now (10%).
deploy-bot: rollout 9f3a2 started: canary 10% -> monitoring.
maya: watching. no alerts so far.

liz: CANARY CHECK: 10% stable for 5m. p95 +9% (within threshold). moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: canary transitioned to 50%.
tom: node-pool metrics show expected CPU bump, autoscaler stable.
maya: still clean.
akshay: proceeding to 100% in 10m if no regressions.

liz: all good from smoke. ready to close the thread after 1hr post-cutover. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout 9f3a2 complete: 100% applied to slice-7.
maya: marking monitors on 1hr watch. will escalate if anything is off.
akshay: thanks everyone. rollback plan if needed: set canary_fraction=0 and revert policy to v2 snapshot id = pol-v2-1342, ops runbook step 3. I'll paste exact command if we need it.

liz: copy. I'll file a short postmortem if we see any anomalies.
tom: logs folder: gs://redwood-logs/slice-7/deploys/1919999000/
akshay: closing this thread in ~1hr unless someone flags. appreciate the quick help!
